description: This file contains utility functions for handling external OAuth providers within SuiteCRM, including generating connector selection HTML and retrieving redirect URIs.

methods.name: getExternalOAuthProviderConnectors
methods.description: Generates HTML select element for OAuth provider connectors or returns the connector value based on view context.

methods.name: getExternalOAuthProviderRedirectURI
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI for the given ExternalOAuthProvider object.
